editorial.blurb: A beloved Little Village institution where authentic Mexican flavors shine in every bite, tucked inside a grocery store that feels like stepping into Mexico itself.
editorial.insiderTip: Order extra tacos—they're smaller than expected—and don't miss the complimentary cebollitas asadas and chiles asados served tableside; the horchata and aguas frescas are perfect cooling counterbalances to the spicy salsas.
